reason: NBG moved to the updated IMF guide for Financial Soundness Indicators in 2022. For 2022 the archive file (quarter 4) and the current file (December) give the same capital and return on assets, but bad loans differ (1.7% against 1.5%) and return on equity differs (30.2% against 24.8%). Values before and after are on different bases, so no change across the break may be computed.
source_note: Archive FSI_Deposit_Takers_eng, 2022Q4 (Nonperforming loans by IMF's methodology 1.66%, Return on Equity 30.21%) against current FSD, December 2022 (1.51%, 24.79%). The current file notes: "Data is calculated according to the 2019 FSI Methodology." and "Due to the implementation of the IFRS, data has been reviewed starting from 2023-01."
